name: x-engagement-assistant
description: Standalone cross-platform desktop X (Twitter) reply engagement assistant with Playwright, Next.js, and Electron

scripts.build: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('.next', { recursive: true, force: true })" && next build && node scripts/build-electron.js
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run package:chromium && electron-builder
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run package:chromium && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm run package:chromium && electron-builder --mac
